Research

My work connects political communication, media studies, and AI governance. Across these areas, I turn difficult theoretical concepts into measurable phenomena and study them at scale.

01

Collective attention

How media storms, viral moments, and other sudden concentrations of attention form, unfold, and disrupt routine agendas.

02

Political visibility

Who breaks through during moments of intense coverage—and whether temporary prominence becomes lasting political voice.

03

AI and society

How AI research engages societal concerns, and how AI systems are transforming persuasion, polarization, and social-science research.
